title: Methacetin-oxidation estimated by respiratory sensing for evaluation of liver grafts during midthermic machine perfusion
summary: Donor livers are increasingly being machine perfused prior to transplantation. Conventional measurements provide only an incomplete assessment of organ function. This study investigates whether the metabolism of a substance labeled with the stable, non-radioactive carbon isotope 13C can predict early liver function after transplantation.

interventions.name: Measurement of methacetin metabolic turnover during isolated liver perfusion and correlation of the measured value with organ function after transplantation

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
waiting list for liver transplantation
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy, technical inability to measure, transplant not performed for primary analysis
